bullets: Added a Windows floor-only containment arm for sponsored runs, gating desktop_windows serving behind the FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS switch and the on value only.
Added per-OS sponsored agentic switches for Windows and Linux desktop, with Linux additionally requiring a bwrap sandbox proof before reporting capability.
Added Windows path validation and safe write staging to the sponsored file layer, refusing reparse-point redirects and exposing probeSponsoredFileLayer in the SDK.
Added a shared env-template matcher used by sponsored writes and outcome checks to distinguish committed example files from sensitive credential files.
Changed the Windows Desktop serving gate from a per-campaign whitelist to a single FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS on switch, removing the campaign list filter.
Fixed git resolution on macOS so sponsored local runs find the real developer directory git instead of the xcode-select shim before exec.
Fixed BYOK DeepSeek requests to backfill empty reasoning_content on assistant tool-call messages, avoiding server-side 400 validation failures.
Fixed FirstMessage CAPI tracking to treat accepted status as delivered, stopping duplicate sends and false failure logs.
Improved MCP tool exposure by sanitizing and hashing tool names containing dots, spaces, slashes, or colons so all providers accept them.
Improved auth login parsing to accept null name fields by coercing them to empty strings instead of failing at startup.
Added a new project profile reporting tool surfaced to free cost mode root agents and registered it as an agent_control capability.
Added agentic offer route wire contract fields and moved its cutover to the FREEBUFF_AGENTIC_ADS channel switch instead of route mode.
Bumped the Freebuffer CLI version to 0.0.195 across the release manifest commits.
